comments.author: @ROYAL-hk5ks
comments.text:
I have been a cosmetology instructor for over 40 years and am licensed in three different countries. I have never seen anything like this. I feel terrible for her.  

She should file a formal complaint with the appropriate regulatory authorities and legal channels. She must take photos and document everything before her hair grows back. 

Not only does she deserve a full refund, but she should also receive free services—such as a complimentary haircut or corrective treatments—to restore customer satisfaction.

Perm services are among the worst and most financially wasteful. When I had perm clients in the past, I sat down with them, discussed the consequences, and changed their minds. They were always happy and appreciated my honesty about perms, and they left satisfied. 

As a professional cosmetologist, I will never recommend perm services to anyone. It is one of the most dangerous chemical services, and it is not healthy or safe at all. 😔
